# OpenUI Cloud

OpenUI Cloud by Thesys generates interactive user interfaces and manages conversations and artifacts through OpenAI-compatible APIs.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/openui/.

## Actions

- **Create Conversation**: Create a managed OpenUI conversation that can receive persisted turns from Generate UI.
- **Delete Conversation**: Permanently delete one managed OpenUI conversation by ID.
- **Generate UI**: Generate an OpenUI response from text or structured Responses API input.
- **Get Artifact** (read-only): Retrieve one persisted OpenUI artifact, including its complete renderable content.
- **List Artifacts** (read-only): List persisted OpenUI artifacts, optionally filtering by name or artifact kinds, one cursor-controlled page at a time.
- **List Conversation Items** (read-only): Read one cursor-controlled page of persisted messages and function-call items from a managed OpenUI conversation.
- **List Conversations** (read-only): List managed OpenUI conversations visible to the connected organization, one cursor-controlled page at a time.
- **Rename Conversation**: Change the title of an existing managed OpenUI conversation.
